description: Enable site search & collections (kv → do-sqlite), one-way. Unlocks search_content, collection indexes, visitor /__paige/search, moves an R2 form ledger into SiteDb. 409 blocked: `reason` names the gate: unsupported backend (never overridable); strictDrafts (default true) on unpublished drafts or unrecovered KV rows; or an incomplete-looking KV snapshot, the only gate force:true overrides (judge `audit` counts first). Anything outside the frozen snapshot is unreachable afterwards.

force.description: Proceed past the incomplete-KV-snapshot 409 only (not unsupported-backend or strictDrafts). Read the blocked `reason` + `audit` first: rows outside the snapshot are lost for good. Default false.

strictDrafts.description: Block on unpublished drafts or unrecovered KV rows (default true; publish/discard first, or false to proceed).

name: graduate_site
